records.title: BHOPAL-OBEDULLAGANJ FOUR -LANE ROAD TO A SIX-LANE ROAD
details:
The existing Misrod (Bhopal)–Obedullaganj section of NH-46 is 4-lane road and
preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR) has already been taken up for upgradation to 6-lane
configuration to meet the traffic requirement. The commencement of work will be taken up after
completion of DPR and acquisition of land and other clearances required for the project.

records.title: MODERNIZATION OF NARMADAPURAM OBSERVATORY
details:
India Meteorological Department (IMD) is taking all necessary efforts to get permanent land
allocation for the construction of a new office building to relocate this observatory. IMD
is coordinating with the district administration for getting new land.

records.title: IMPLEMENTATION STATUS OF RDSS AND SMART METERING PROGRESS
details:
